_rules: One primary per week (two in Week 1), no repeats. Rushing/receiving/return TDs count, passing TDs do not. The alternate only subs in if the primary is inactive, and is not burned if unused.
_used_note: 'Robinson' is assumed to be Bijan (Bi.Robinson). If you actually used Brian Robinson Jr., change it to Br.Robinson|ATL.
_market_note: Week-8 anytime-TD prices collected Oct 28-29, 2026 (BetMGM unless noted). The model de-vigs them and blends them 50/50 with its own projection.
_injury_note: Availability multipliers for Week 8 (1.0 = healthy). Q = 0.85, doubtful = 0.3, out = 0. Re-check the official report before lock.

model._min_games_note: Small samples (a FB with 1 TD in 2 games) blow up share-based projections. Anyone with a market price this week is kept regardless.
model._stale_note: Players with no snaps in the last N weeks (IR, e.g. Achane) are dropped.
